semantics.location_loss: masked by (gt_kpt[...,2] != 0); class1 v=0 contributes exactly 0 to the keypoint coordinate loss
semantics.visibility_loss: kobj = BCE(pred_vis, mask.float()); class1 v=0 is supervised toward visibility 0 (intended, not a coordinate leak)
semantics.class_agnostic: the mask has no class branch; two-class semantics live entirely in the labels
semantics.v_encoding: ndim=3 pose labels keep the written v; only v=2 or other non-zero values would count as visible; the label builder must enforce v in {0,1} (never v=2)
semantics.placeholder: v=0 rows still contain normalized xy in the txt; label builder must write 0,0 for class1 (never bbox centre) and no code may treat the v=0 xy as a reference point

required_builder_checks_for_two_class: class1 keypoint xy written as 0,0 and v=0 (never bbox centre)
class0 keypoint v=1 only when the green roof light is visible/locatable; v=0 otherwise
v is in {0,1} for every instance; reject v=2 or other non-zero values in QA
same-frame completeness QA: every visible/decidable MS1 instance labelled; MS1 never left as background
class1 bbox present for every class1 instance (bbox loss still supervised; only the keypoint coordinate loss is masked)
keypoint-mask regression test on the real v6 dataset: pick one class1 v=0 row and one class0 v=1 row, recompute the mask/loss contribution
